ABOUT THE ARCHIVE

A living record of Metropolitan.

This first edition brings together all 24 monthly newsletters supplied for 2023 and 2024. More years can be added using the same archive structure.

How to search

Search for people, brands, places and events. “All keywords” finds pages containing every word; “Any keyword” broadens the results. Choose “Exact phrase” or put a phrase in quotation marks for a precise match. Filters work together, and your search can be shared by copying the page URL.

What a result represents

Each result is an original newsletter page, which can contain more than one news story. Categories and brand tags are automatically suggested from the page text. A page may appear in several categories; category counts overlap.

Source accuracy

Year and month follow the uploaded filenames, because some printed issue headings are inconsistent. These are publication dates, not necessarily event dates. Scanned pages use optical character recognition (OCR). PDF copies are optimised for web viewing. Verify names, dates and figures against the original page or source PDF; some decorative or photographed text may not be captured.

Your collection

Bookmarks and notes stay in your current browser. They are not shared between devices or users. Export results to keep a separate CSV copy. The export contains page references and transcripts.
